culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investments (1) | Footnotes | Investment | Reference Rate and Spread | Interest Rate (2) | Maturity Date | Par Amount/ Shares (3) | Cost (4) | Fair Value | Percentage of Net Assets

rationale: FX01 requires a non-USD source par amount before missing principal_amount_usd is a data defect. The raw SOI schedule header labels the source column only as Par Amount/Shares, with explicit dollar marks on Cost and Fair Value, and a sampled flagged debt row shows numeric par without a non-USD currency marker. Targeted source searches found no EUR, CAD, denomination, or U.S. dollars schedule evidence; the only foreign-currency hit is an income/transaction line, not an investment par disclosure. Therefore the row-validation premise that these debt par amounts are non-USD is not supported by the raw source, so the missing USD-converted principal flag is a false alarm rather than a holdings data error.
